description: Scrape TikTok playlists — discover all playlists for a profile and extract all videos within them.

maxPlaylistsPerProfile.description: Maximum number of playlists to scrape when discovering playlists for a profile.
maxPlaylistsPerProfile.title: Max Playlists Per Profile

maxPostsPerPlaylist.description: Maximum number of videos to extract per playlist. Higher values take longer but return more complete results.
maxPostsPerPlaylist.title: Max Posts Per Playlist

mode.description: Choose what data to return: playlist metadata rows only, post/video rows only, or both together.
mode.title: Scraping Mode

playlistIds.description: Numeric playlist/mix IDs as strings (15–20 digits). Use instead of or together with Playlist URLs.
playlistIds.title: Playlist IDs (Mix IDs)

playlistUrls.description: TikTok playlist URLs to scrape. E.g. https://www.tiktok.com/@natgeo/playlist/Cinematic-7509464647364283178
playlistUrls.title: Playlist URLs

profileUrls.description: TikTok profile URLs. All playlists for each user will be discovered and scraped.
profileUrls.title: Profile URLs

usernames.description: TikTok usernames (with or without @). All playlists for each user will be discovered and scraped.
usernames.title: Usernames

title: TikTok Playlist Scraper Input
